title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Section_8
doc_notes: This document is an FBI case file (62-HQ-83894) containing various reports, correspondence, and newspaper clippings regarding flying saucer sightings, contactee claims, and the activities of flying saucer clubs. / This file contains various FBI reports, memoranda, and correspondence regarding UFO sightings, including investigations into claims by Senator Russell, civilian reports, and alleged contactee accounts.

encounters.summary: Truman Bethurum claimed to have been aboard flying saucers on eleven occasions and to have met a crew of space explorers led by a woman commandant in the Nevada desert.
Mrs. Frances Swan claimed to receive telepathic messages from beings on space ships designated M-4 and L-11, managed by 'Affa' and 'Ponnar', who are repairing fault lines in the Pacific Ocean.
encounters.communication_content: Messages regarding flying saucers, life on other planets, and protection of Earth from atomic destruction.
encounters.entity_appearance: Space ships 150 miles wide, 200 miles long, 100 miles deep.
encounters.entity_behavior: Repairing fault lines in the Pacific Ocean.

encounters.summary: Franz Hoge reported a cigar-shaped craft hovering six feet above the ground and observed four creatures.
encounters.entity_appearance: Three and one-half feet in height, thick-set bodies, oversized heads, delicate legs.

encounters.summary: Senator Richard B. Russell and his party observed two greenish-yellow glowing balls rising rapidly while traveling by train in Russia.
encounters.quote: small greenish-yellow glowing ball rising quite rapidly in sky

encounters.summary: Sylvia L. Richards and Joseph L. Morris, Jr. observed a low-flying, oval-shaped, bright light blue object while driving.
encounters.entity_appearance: oval shaped, bright, light blue, spinning
encounters.quote: oval-shaped, low-flying object coming directly towards their car

encounters.summary: Thomas Gamble (Billy Thomas Gambill) observed a bright yellow light traveling at high speed.
encounters.quote: solid, bright, yellow light, visible from all directions

encounters.summary: Tod Kittredge reported a spherical vehicle landed in his yard and entities invited him for a ride.
encounters.communication_content: invited him to ride in their ship
encounters.quote: some little green men emerged from the vehicle and invited KITTREDGE to ride

encounters.summary: Wladyslaw Krasuski observed a circular vehicle while a prisoner of war in Germany.
encounters.quote: circular in shape, seventy-five to one hundred yards in diameter
